$comment: dfdl design-system lint policy. Mechanical rules live here; judgment lives in the skill. Consumers extend this file. Contracts are added per component as each one ships.

shadcn/no-raw-colors.message: Use a dfdl semantic color (bg-surface, text-fg-secondary, border-line, bg-accent-solid, ...) from {{file}}. Primitives and Tailwind palette colors are not allowed in components.

shadcn/no-arbitrary-values.message: Stay on the dfdl scale. Spacing is multiples of 8 (minor) and 24 (major); radii are rounded-xs/sm/md/lg/xl/full; add a token if a value is genuinely missing.

message.spacing: {{component}} owns its padding. Use a size ({{sizes}}) or put margin/gap on the parent.
message.typography: {{component}} owns its type. Pick a variant or size instead of overriding font classes.
message.color: {{component}} owns its color. Use a variant; add one in the component only if the design calls for it.
